Portronics Power Shutter Pro Power Bank – 10000mAh Fast Charging Powerbank

The Portronics Power Shutter Pro Power Bank is designed for users who demand speed, reliability, and modern convenience in a compact charging solution. With a powerful 10000mAh powerbank capacity, this device ensures your smartphone, earbuds, smartwatch, or tablet stays charged wherever you go. Featuring an in built Type C PD cable, a bidirectional Type C port, and super-fast charging support, this power bank delivers efficiency without carrying extra cables.

Available in elegant Black and White color options, the Portronics Power Shutter Pro blends premium design with cutting-edge power delivery technology. Whether you are traveling, working remotely, or commuting daily, this fast charging power bank is the ideal companion for uninterrupted performance.

Fast & Reliable 10000mAh Powerbank for Everyday Use

Equipped with a high-density lithium battery, this 10000mAh power bank can charge most smartphones up to two times on a single charge. The advanced Power Delivery (PD) technology intelligently adjusts output to ensure safe and efficient charging for Android smartphones, iPhones, Bluetooth devices, and other USB-powered gadgets.

The bidirectional Type C port allows you to both charge the power bank and power your devices using the same port, making it extremely convenient and travel-friendly. This feature reduces clutter and ensures faster recharge times for the itself.

In Built Type C PD Cable – No Extra Accessories Needed

One of the standout features of the is its in built Type C PD cable. This eliminates the need to carry additional charging cables, making it perfect for users who value minimalism and efficiency. The integrated cable supports fast charging and is durable enough for daily use. This makes the device an excellent choice for professionals, students, and frequent travelers looking for a reliable fast charging power bank with modern connectivity.

Super-Fast Charging with Advanced Safety Protection

Experience super-fast charging with optimized power output that significantly reduces charging time. The intelligent chipset protects your devices against overcharging, overheating, overvoltage, and short circuits, ensuring complete safety during use. The Power Shutter Pro complies with international safety standards, making it safe for flights and long journeys. The LED indicators clearly display battery status, so you always know when it’s time to recharge.

Key Features & Benefits

  • 10000mAh high-capacity fast charging power bank
  • In built Type C PD cable for cable-free convenience
  • Bidirectional Type C port for input and output
  • Super-fast charging with Power Delivery technology
  • Compatible with Android, iPhone, tablets, and accessories
  • Advanced multi-layer safety protection
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design
  • Available in Black and White color variants

Why Choose?

If you are searching for a reliable Portronics power bank 10000mAh that combines performance, portability, and smart features, the Power Shutter Pro stands out as a premium choice. Its integrated cable, fast charging capability, and modern Type C interface make it future-ready and extremely practical. Ideal for corporate gifting, personal use, or daily travel, this fast charging powerbank offers excellent value with trusted build quality. Stay powered throughout the day with a smart, stylish, and dependable charging solution.
